# Extract the regexes from the ReprHighlighter instance

# ReprHighlighter inherits from RegexHighlighter, which has a 'regex' attribute (compiled)

# Let's just test the updated regex directly as per the plan.

url_with_tilde = "https://example.com/~user/path"
# Original regex (without ~)
regex_old = re.compile(r"(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#]*)")
# New regex (with ~)
regex_new = re.compile(r"(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#~]*)")

match_old = regex_old.search(url_with_tilde)
match_new = regex_new.search(url_with_tilde)

print(f"Old match: {match_old.group('url') if match_old else 'None'}")
print(f"New match: {match_new.group('url') if match_new else 'None'}")
